_artifact_note: Transcription of the Consensus MCP `search` response of 2026-08-10, not the raw bytes: the MCP transport returns the result into the conversation rather than as a file, so it cannot be byte-preserved. It is COMPLETE with respect to records — all 20 returned papers are listed in the order returned, with no selection — and each record keeps every field the response carried EXCEPT the abstract. Abstracts are publisher-copyrighted and this repository's evidence packets retain bibliographic metadata only (see data/science-evidence/2026-08-03-breast-prs77-availability-2028/queries.json, which records the same retention rule). The prose reading of these results is in evidence-ladder-2026-08-10.md.

_identifiers_note: Consensus returns its own paper URLs but no PMID or DOI, so identifiers were resolved separately via PubMed on 2026-08-10 for every record this packet actually cites in a claim (the nomenclature-split examples that are quoted, and the direction-of-effect conflict). Records marked used_in_packet_claim: false are retained for completeness of the result set - so a reviewer can see what was returned and not selected - and are not cited anywhere, so no identifier is asserted for them. Titles alone are not durable identifiers and are not treated as such.
